description: IPC surface available to the 'shell' webview ONLY (the DeployGuard overlay). Deliberately scoped by webview label, not window label — the 'main' window also hosts the 'odoo' webview (Odoo itself, filling the window), which gets ZERO capabilities, per docs/deployguard/16-security-architecture.md §7. Even though both webviews share the same window, this 'webviews' scoping (rather than 'windows') keeps them isolated.
